name: Sunwell Plateau
shortDescription: Sunwell Plateau, a Burning Crusade setting in the Shattered Sun research story.
body: The raid complex and fount at the heart of the patch-2.4 campaign. Story images are original relational illustrations and do not assert an exact room layout.
